_note: Settings for calibrate_by_placing.py and run_vision_pick_place.py. Joint values are in the Processing GUI frame.
_park_note: Park = the repeatable pose the arm is in when the controller powers on/resets (GUI all zeros). The camera must see the cylinder with the arm here.
_elbow_note: 0 = either elbow direction, choosing the least joint travel from park. 1 or -1 forces the sign of GUI J2.
